# Agent K C++ project tools

Pass a unique CMake workspace folder name, not a path. Call agent_k with capability cpp-language-server for semantic symbols, definitions, references, diagnostics, hover, call/type hierarchy, and explicit language-service lifecycle. Put action at the top level and workspace, symbol, query, or file in arguments. Call status first and treat indexing results as partial.

Call agent_k with capability native-debugger instead of invoking GDB, LLDB, WinDbg, or a DAP adapter from the shell. Put action at the top level and all debugger values in arguments. Call status first, then configurations for launch targets or processes for an explicit attach. Preserve the returned sessionId. Stop terminates the target and removes the session; detach keeps the target running and removes the session. Prefer detach for attached processes unless termination was explicitly requested. Dump sessions are read-only. Only write memory or variables in a stopped live session after an explicit user request. Addresses and instruction breakpoints are session-local because ASLR can invalidate them.
